title: Drawing the high-level design

kcs.statement: A high-level design traces each core request from client through the application tier to the data tier, with one box per responsibility and arrows labelled by API call.
Start the high-level design with the simplest version that meets the functional requirements, then add components only when an estimate or non-functional requirement demands them.

problem_ideas: Draw the minimal boxes for a Pastebin: client, app server, metadata store, blob store
Trace a 'create short URL' request and a 'redirect' request through the same diagram
Remove the unjustified component from a 12-box design for a 1,000-user app
Split the read path and write path of a news feed into separate arrows
Name the box that owns each functional requirement in a chat app diagram
Explain to an interviewer why you started with a single database
